view.stem: 做两种折纸构造：先在纸上作直线AB与图形P，沿AB对折，在P的几个点处扎穿两层，展开并标出点对；再把另一张纸对折，穿过两层剪出任意图形，展开。选择关于这两种完整构造的所有正确判断。

options.text: 离开折痕的同一扎眼对应两点：它们连线垂直折痕，中点在折痕上，可把各对依次标为$P_i,Q_i$。
两张纸上的对应图形都只须沿折痕平行平移得到；各对扎点可以在折痕同侧。
剪形展开后的完整图形关于折痕不变；它的两半互为镜像，但任意剪法并不保证只有一个连通部分。
若扎点恰在折痕上，它展开后仍是一个自相对应的点，不必成为两个不同点。
把折痕上一固定点当中心旋转180°，一定会得到所有扎点的配对和任意剪形的另一半。

intent.task: 做两种折纸构造：先在纸上作直线AB与图形P，沿AB对折，在P的几个点处扎穿两层，展开并标出点对；再把另一张纸对折，穿过两层剪出任意图形，展开。选择关于这两种完整构造的所有正确判断。
intent.source_solution:
源任务371：
Task: draw any line AB and figure P, fold along AB, pierce several points through
both layers, unfold and name several pairs. There is no prescribed unique P;
that is legitimate construction freedom, not missing numerical data.

Use local coordinates with AB as y=0. For every pierced point P_i=(u_i,v_i),
the paired hole is Q_i=(u_i,-v_i). The two holes have the same along-axis
coordinate; their midpoint (u_i,0) lies on AB and P_iQ_i is perpendicular to AB.
If v_i=0 the point is self-paired. Name the pairs P_1,Q_1; P_2,Q_2; etc.
The reflected complete point set is R(P), not an arbitrary equal-area figure.
The physical two-layer piercing/folding and autonomous drawing/naming cannot
be certified by a choice response.

源任务387：
Fold paper along a crease and cut an arbitrary contour through both layers.
If one half's retained region is S, unfolding gives S union R(S), so the whole
retained figure is invariant under reflection in the crease. Every off-crease
point has its counterpart; crease points are fixed. Cuts/detached components
are allowed by the arbitrary construction; do not claim one unique silhouette
or infer that every possible cut makes one connected piece.
The two halves are reflected, not merely translated or rotated copies.
The physical folding/scissor production cannot be certified by selection.
intent.unit_reason: 两种原任务都以折痕决定全点集反射，但点对命名与剪形整体不变性不同；合成一个自然多选，同时覆盖两类完整构造，不按每个扎眼拆题。
limitations: 保留多个孔对命名、折痕固定点及任意剪形全点集反射；选择不证明亲自折叠、扎眼、剪裁、展开和自主画标点。

rationales.derivation: 取折痕y=0，两个层上的同孔展开为(u,v)/(u,-v)，v非0；连线竖直且中点(u,0)，可对每孔命名，不限一个固定孔数。
平行平移保持到折痕的有符号垂距，不会把v改为-v；离折痕孔对应在异侧，剪形两半也应互为反射。
rationales.misconception: 把展开对折纸当作沿折痕滑动，错误以平行平移替代反射并保留同侧位置。

rationales.derivation: 设半张保留点集S，展开为S并R(S)，再反射仍为同一集合；任意切割允许分离小块，不能另加连通条件。
v=0时(u,0)反射不变；两个层的孔在折痕同一点重合。
在折痕y=0以原点半转把(u,v)变(-u,-v)，而反射给(u,-v)；u非0时不相同，所以不能对任意孔/形成立。
rationales.misconception: 将折叠的轴反射误作绕某个折痕点的中心对称，连沿轴坐标也取反。

view.stem: 按图1、图2分别描出直线m及AB、CD。以下每项提出一种完整面板构造；选择所有能得到该面板两条关于m对称线段的方案。图1的距离以网格一格为单位。

options.text: 图1：A上移2格，B上移10格，C、D各下移6格；分别连接新A与新B、新C与新D。
图2：A、B、D分别向m作垂线，到垂足后各再延长原垂距，取另一侧端点；C保留原位，连接新A与新B、C与新D。
图1：把整个AB上移10格，把整个CD下移6格，再连接各自端点。
图2：A、B、D都水平移动到m的另一侧，使原点与新点到同高度轴点的水平距离相等；C不动，再连接两组端点。

intent.task: 按图1、图2分别描出直线m及AB、CD。以下每项提出一种完整面板构造；选择所有能得到该面板两条关于m对称线段的方案。图1的距离以网格一格为单位。
intent.source_solution:
源任务372：
Actual fig91 has two complete panels. Panel1: m is horizontal; A/B are on one
vertical segment below it, C/D are on a horizontal segment above it. All eight
original labeled endpoints across both panels and both full axes are visible;
the lowest B label and rightmost D/m in panel2 are not cropped.

Panel1 grid origin is its bottom-left corner, x right/y up. Original points are
A=(12,5), B=(12,1), C=(3,9), D=(9,9), and m is y=6. Reflection R(x,y)=(x,12-y)
gives A'=(12,7), B'=(12,11), C'=(3,3), D'=(9,3).
Join A'B' and C'D'. A/B move upward 2/10 squares; C/D move downward 6 squares.
AB remains vertical, length4; CD remains horizontal, length6.

Panel2 uses its own bottom-left grid origin. A=(6,9), B=(6,4),
C=(19/2,14/3), D=(29/2,15/2). Axis m passes through (6,7) and has
y=11-(2/3)x, equivalently 2x+3y-33=0.
For A the signed normal numerator is6, for B it is-9, for C it is0,
for D it is37/2. Therefore:
A'=(54/13,81/13);
B'=(114/13,106/13);
C'=C=(19/2,14/3);
D'=(229/26,-27/26).
Join A'B', C'D'. The original AB crosses the axis at H=(6,7), which remains
the intersection of AB and A'B'. C is fixed because it lies on m. D' is below
the printed grid: extend the drawing area rather than discard the endpoint.
Lengths and perpendicularity of the endpoint-pair displacements are preserved;
horizontal mirroring is not reflection in this oblique m.
intent.unit_reason: 两面板同一反射定义作自然多选；每项覆盖某面板两线段全部四端点，不把轴相交、C固定或每个格子机械拆题。图2以唯一确定全部像点的垂足等距构造保留斜轴，而非只判象限。
limitations: 两图全部端点与原轴关系保留，图2像点允许在原网格外；识别完整构造不能证明亲自描图、作垂线、量距并画出两条完整像线段。

figure_observations.observation: 亲自完整打开实际SVG的两面板1000px图，图1的A/B竖线在水平m下、C/D横线在m上；图2的AB跨斜轴m，C在m上、CD伸向右上，八个端点与两个m轴完整。最低B标签、最右D和第二轴低端未裁切。按实际网格求出所有端点反射，第二面板D像落在原网格下方，不删除它。

rationales.derivation: m:y6，A/B原y5/1需到7/11，C/D原y9需到3；竖直位移+2/+10/-6/-6，沿各自垂线且距轴相等，连接两像线段。
实际C在m，A/B/D均不在m；垂足为点对中点，等距延长唯一产生A'(54/13,81/13)、B'(114/13,106/13)、D'(229/26,-27/26)，C固定；全部两线段正确。
CD正确，AB平移后B到y11正确但A到y15而非7；A对轴原距1却像距9，不能是全部AB反射。
rationales.misconception: 只用B的反射位移10格平移整条AB，未按A自身距轴反射。

rationales.derivation: 各点对中点虽可落斜轴，但XX'水平并不垂直斜m，不能满足反射。C固定不能挽救A/B/D全部错用水平对称。
rationales.misconception: 把竖直轴才适用的同高水平翻转照搬到斜轴m，以横距代替垂距。

view.stem: 作折线ABC及与BC相交的直线n。设H是它们的一个交点。哪种完整作法总能得到折线ABC关于n的对称图形，包括端点或整段落在n上的情形？

options.text: 只把A反射得到A′，保留B、C，连接A′B、BC；交点H不动。
分别反射A、B、C；在n上的顶点保留，其他顶点沿过它的垂线在轴另一侧取等距点；连接A′B′、B′C′，H仍属于新BC边。
分别反射A、B、C后只连接A′C′；H在轴上，仍应成为新图的点。
沿n平移整个折线，使H留在原位；A、B、C也都不改变位置。

intent.task: 作折线ABC及与BC相交的直线n。设H是它们的一个交点。哪种完整作法总能得到折线ABC关于n的对称图形，包括端点或整段落在n上的情形？
intent.source_solution:
源任务373：
Task: freely construct a non-collinear polyline A-B-C and a line n intersecting
BC, then reflect the complete polyline. Let R_n be the above reflection map.
Construct A',B',C' separately and join A'B',B'C' in that order. Every axis point,
including H=n intersect BC, is fixed. H belongs to both BC and B'C'.
If n contains BC then B and C are both fixed and BC is unchanged; if n meets
BC only at an endpoint that endpoint is fixed. Do not invent an interior-only
intersection or assume A cannot lie on n. A is fixed exactly when A lies on n.
Two edge lengths, their joint at B', and angle ABC are preserved; connecting
A' directly to C' omits the required bend.
Free choices do not determine one unique numerical coordinate output.
Actual polyline/axis construction and endpoint labeling remain production loss.
intent.unit_reason: 保留自由作线、BC与轴相交、完整两边及B连接点；答案为确定全部像点的完整构造，不捏造唯一坐标或额外排除端点/共线情形。
limitations: 自由折线/轴的数值位置本来不唯一；完整作法识别保留全部原任务关系，不能证明独立作图、标三个像点并处理交点。

rationales.derivation: H固定正确，但B/C不一定在n，故通常都应反射；只反射A不会产生整个两边图形。
rationales.misconception: 见BC与轴有交点便把整个BC当作位于轴上，漏反射B/C。

rationales.derivation: 每个点按唯一反射构造，线段像为其端点像的连线；H位于n固定，所以H属于B'C'。共线时B/C固定，端点交时该端点固定，均成立。
A'C'是两外端点的弦，通常不含B'或H，丢掉AB/BC的折线结构；非共线的折线不能用弦替代。
rationales.misconception: 把折线看成起点到终点的直线段，反射后删去中间顶点B'及两边连接顺序。

rationales.derivation: 沿轴平移且固定H只能为零平移，等于原图；原图未必关于n不变，不能得到另一侧像。
rationales.misconception: 认为轴上有固定交点就要求整个原图固定，把反射误作零位移。

view.stem: 描图中的四边形ABCD并作它关于m的像。哪张表给出全部四顶点从原位置到像位置的正确位移？网格一格为1，向右、向上取正；完成后按A′B′C′D′顺序闭合。

intent.task: 描图中的四边形ABCD并作它关于m的像。哪张表给出全部四顶点从原位置到像位置的正确位移？网格一格为1，向右、向上取正；完成后按A′B′C′D′顺序闭合。
intent.source_solution:
源任务374：
Actual fig92 is a complete closed quadrilateral crossing horizontal m twice.
Using the bottom-left grid corner, A=(3,6), B=(9,9), C=(13,5), D=(10,2), m:y=7.
R(x,y)=(x,14-y), so
A'=(3,8), B'=(9,5), C'=(13,9), D'=(10,12).
Join A'B'C'D'A', maintaining the four-edge order. AB intersects m at (5,7),
BC at (11,7); both crossings remain fixed. C remains the far-right vertex,
while the lowest original D becomes the highest reflected D'. No vertex lies
on m. A/B/C/D move vertically +2/-4/+4/+10 grid squares respectively.
All four edges, their lengths, angles and enclosed area reflect together.
The actual axis ends, far-right C and lowest D/D-label are fully visible.
intent.unit_reason: 完整四端点的有向精确位移决定整个四边形，不只判断哪侧，也不复制原坐标；四边顺序与原图双交轴关系保留。
limitations: 精确四顶点及闭合边序识别保留；不能证明描原图、画四条垂线、量取像点并实际构造整个四边形。

figure_observations.observation: 实际SVG完整闭合四边形A-B-C-D；水平m穿过AB和BC，A/C/D在下、B在上。最右C、最低D及标签、完整轴两端均可见。网格反射保持各顶点水平位置，垂直位移分别+2/-4/+4/+10格；全部四边和两个固定交点保留。

rationales.derivation: 这些是从原点到m垂足的位移，各为完整反射位移的一半；全落y7，不会成为合同四边形。
rationales.misconception: 作垂足后停止，把轴上的垂足当像点，未再延长相等垂距。

rationales.derivation: 将正确反射向量全取反，A/B/C/D到y4/13/1/-8，均背离应有镜像位置。
rationales.misconception: 求得两倍垂距但朝离轴更远方向延长，没有先穿过轴。

rationales.derivation: m:y7，原y6/9/5/2反射到8/5/9/12，水平位置不变；四位移+2/-4/+4/+10全部确定闭合像。
仅沿A的正确位移将整个图上移2，B/C/D到y11/7/4而应5/9/12；C被推到轴上但原C不在轴。
rationales.misconception: 用一个顶点的反射位移平移整个四边形，未逐点反射。

view.stem: 作长方形ABCD，AB为5厘米、BC为3厘米，取对角线AC为反射轴。选择所有正确的完整构造或像图形结论。

options.text: 保留A、C；分别将B、D沿到AC的垂线在轴另一侧取等距像点B′、D′，顺次连接A、B′、C、D′。
保留A、C，把B与D交换位置，就得到了关于AC的像长方形。
像图形仍有相邻边长5厘米和3厘米，四个直角，面积15平方厘米、周长16厘米。
把B、D分别投影到AC，用两个垂足代替B′、D′，A与C不动，也能构成所求长方形。

intent.task: 作长方形ABCD，AB为5厘米、BC为3厘米，取对角线AC为反射轴。选择所有正确的完整构造或像图形结论。
intent.source_solution:
源任务375：
Construct rectangle ABCD with AB=5cm and BC=3cm. Choose an equivalent placement
A=(0,0), B=(5,0), C=(5,3), D=(0,3), coordinates in centimeters.
The reflection axis AC is 3x-5y=0. Normal reflection has matrix
[[8/17,15/17],[15/17,-8/17]], giving
A'=A=(0,0), C'=C=(5,3),
B'=(40/17,75/17), D'=(45/17,-24/17).
Construction: reflect B and D through their perpendicular feet on AC, retaining
A/C, then join A-B'-C-D'-A. The images of AB/BC have lengths5/3cm, all angles
remain right angles and area15cm^2. The reflected figure is a congruent
rectangle, but not the original rectangle: AB differs from BC, so diagonal AC
is not its own symmetry axis. In particular B' is not D and D' is not B.
Original construction is free up to rigid placement, with a unique reflection
after a placement is chosen.
intent.unit_reason: 同一矩形斜对角线反射为自然多选，保留5/3不等边、A/C固定、B/D完整构造以及像图形量；不能因是对角线就当自对称轴。
limitations: 尺寸、全部顶点构造和矩形不变量保留；不能证明独立画5乘3矩形、作对角线及实际标两个斜轴像点。

rationales.derivation: B像并非D：B到A距离5而D到A距离3，若轴固定A反射必须保距；B'/D'上述坐标也不等D/B。
rationales.misconception: 照搬正方形对角线交换另两顶点的规律到5乘3非正方形。

rationales.derivation: 反射是等距，保全部边和角；面积5*3=15 cm²，周长2*(5+3)=16 cm。不声称像与原位置相同。
两个垂足都在AC，连同A/C全共线，面积0而非15；投影不是完整反射。
rationales.misconception: 把垂足当反射点，遗漏跨轴等距延长，导致四顶点共线。

view.stem: 观察完整图中六组图形。选择所有两图形关于各自标出的轴互相对称的组；选项用该组的轴字母标识。

intent.task: 观察完整图中六组图形。选择所有两图形关于各自标出的轴互相对称的组；选项用该组的轴字母标识。
intent.source_solution:
源任务376：
Task: identify every symmetric pair about its own marked axis in actual fig93,
not every congruent or similarly oriented pair. Complete actual SVG/artwork
composition has six groups, axes s,l,k,n,a,m. The rightmost k head and lowest
m/circle labels and complete zigzag ends are all visible.

s: yes. Actual SVG axis x=142 maps x to284-x. Left triangle points
(20,117),(58,60),(94,117) map to (264,117),(226,60),(190,117);
left box x8..114 maps to x170..276. Circle centers112 and172 have midpoint142
and equal radii17; the rod, stem and divider at x28 reflect to x256.
Every complete component has its reflected counterpart.

l: yes. Axis x475 maps x to950-x. Left box x390..455 maps to495..560,
same vertical bounds73..109. Circle center(411,91) maps to(539,91),
both radii13. Interior circles, not only the outer boxes, match.

k: no. Actual artwork depicts two same-direction profiles, both facing left;
reflection in the vertical k would face the counterpart right. Their nose
indentations occur on the same respective side, so corresponding shape points
do not reflect even though the placement is on opposite sides of k.

n: no. Axis y284 would map upper square x386..458, y202..274 to the same
x386..458, y294..366. Actual lower square occupies x458..530, so it is shifted
sideways by72 SVG units. Equal size and opposite sides do not suffice.

a: no. Axis y384 maps upper endpoint(10,364) to(10,404), while lower starts
(10,504). Upper first high vertex(68,274) should map to(68,494), not the
lower first high vertex(41,412). The top short initial horizontal run ends at
x40 but the bottom run ends atx18; the complete zigzags do not correspond.

m: yes. Axis x470 maps x to940-x; equal-radius34 circles with centers
(424,432) and(516,432) are mirror counterparts. Full true set {s,l,m}.
Labels are group/axis labels, not unique point names across separate groups.
intent.unit_reason: 六图同一全点集反射定义必须作一题自然多选，各轴单独作为选项；不做组合码或逐图二选一，完整SVG及artwork都须显示。
limitations: 原图六组判断任务全部保留；选择不证明自主书写逐组对称/不对称依据。

figure_observations.observation: 实际SVG和完整PNG artwork分别打开，再按相同完整尺寸叠放亲自观察实际组合：s/l/k/n/a/m六组全可见，s含三角形、圆、杆、竖杆、框及分隔线，l框含内部圆，k两头像同向左；n两正方形横向错位，a两折线整条顶点/端部不对应，m同半径双圆。最右头像、a最右末段、最下圆及m标签完整。实际组合而非spec判断完整真集s/l/m。

rationales.derivation: 轴x142反射x到284-x，完整三角形、圈、杆、竖杆、框和分隔线逐一对应；圆112/172同高同半径且中点142。
轴x475反射x到950-x，两框及内部圆都对应，左圆中心411像539，半径13不变。
实际组合的两个人物都朝左，鼻部凹口在同向侧；竖轴反射应一左一右，全点集不对应。
rationales.misconception: 把两个同方向合同人物置于轴两旁就判反射，忽略朝向以及鼻部点对。

源任务380：
Four independent whole-part/inverse-proportion contexts, with integer domains.
1. Three-room homes=240*.15=36. Let one-room homes=u. (2/3)u=36,
   hence u=54. Two-room homes=240-36-54=150. Check36+54+150=240.
2. Three-seat boats=150*.14=21. (7/8)v=21 gives five-seat boatsv=24.
   Four-seat boats=150-21-24=105. Check21+24+105=150.
3. Rest certificates=350*(2/5)=140. Rest is70% of tour certificates:
   .70t=140 gives t=200. Treatment certificates=350-140-200=10.
4. Linden trees=450*(2/5)=180. .90p=180 gives pine treesp=200.
   Birch trees=450-180-200=70.
Every count is a nonnegative integer and both relations and total check exactly.
No invented percentage of the total may replace the indicated subgroup ratio.

源任务385：
Construct a circle of radius2.7cm and a secant x with two distinct points A,B.
The line AB equals x. Let O be the original center; draw the perpendicular foot
H of O on AB and place O' with H the midpoint of OO'. Then draw the circle
centered at O', radius2.7cm. A and B are fixed because they lie on the axis.
The reflected circle is congruent and passes through both A/B.
If AB passes through O (a diameter), O'=O and the circle is its own reflected
image; the source does not exclude this case. If the center is off AB, the
two distinct circles meet exactly at A/B, with mirrored centers.
Do not replace radius by5.4cm (that is the diameter) or assume all secants are
symmetry axes of the original circle. Drawing radius/secant/center reflection
and final complete circumference remains a production task.
